title: IntentClassification
description: Grammar-constrained output of the small-LLM intent classifier tiebreak pass. Rule-based classifier produces the same shape directly.

instrument.description: Instrument name or short form mentioned in the query, e.g. 'RTI Act 2017' or 'Sindh Local Government Act'.

topic.description: Subject mentioned in the query, e.g. 'penalties', 'arms license', 'building plan approval'.

comparands.description: For Difference / CrossCompare — list of instrument names or section references to compare. Empty unless intent in {difference, cross_compare}.

timeline_anchor.description: For Timeline — the section, instrument, or topic the timeline is anchored on.
